race.title: PricedUp BOG From 10am Selling Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: BRIGHT LEGEND is given another chance back down in trip and with a tongue strap re-fitted. Latin is the obvious threat having gone very close on his final start for Olly Murphy at Plumpton 3 weeks ago. BRIGHT LEGEND (IRE) LATIN (IRE) CAN'T RESIST IT
race.bettingForecast: Latin (7/4), Can't Resist It (11/4), Bright Legend (3/1), Blackwater Lilly (7/1), Westerton (16/1), Stopherandgo (20/1), Polemon (33/1)
